summary: A wrapper that lets you drag and drop its children to reorder them.
description: A light wrapper that makes its slotted children (matched by itemSelector, or a narrower dragSelector for a drag handle) draggable and reorderable via native HTML5 drag-and-drop. Shows a drop-position indicator and dispatches dragstarted/dragended/reorder events carrying the dragged/target elements and computed indices; consumers perform the actual DOM reordering in response. Also exports a standalone isReorderKeyboardEvent(event) helper (ctrl+shift+up/down) for wiring an equivalent keyboard-driven reorder outside the component's own automatic handling.

attributes.name: itemSelector
attributes.description: Selector for slotted elements that should be reorderable. Reflected as the lowercase HTML attribute itemselector (no explicit attribute name is set on the property, so Lit uses its lowercased default).

attributes.name: dragSelector
attributes.description: Selector used when only part of a reorderable item should be the drag handle (e.g. a button or icon), instead of the whole item. Reflected as the lowercase HTML attribute dragselector.

events.name: reorder
events.description: Dispatched when an item is dropped in a new position. detail: { draggedElement, targetElement, position (-1 before / 0 after target), draggedIndex, targetIndex, insertAt }.

events.name: dragstarted
events.description: Dispatched when an item drag begins. detail: { draggedElement }.

events.name: dragended
events.description: Dispatched when a drag ends (drop or otherwise). detail: { draggedElement }.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Re-queries the assigned elements matching itemSelector, marks them draggable, and records their reorder indices; called on slotchange and DOM mutation.

methods.name: getAssignedElementsBySelector
methods.description: Returns all elements matching a selector among the given root elements (default: the default slot's assigned elements), recursing into shadow roots, children, and nested slots.

methods.name: getDropTargetInfo
methods.description: Computes the current drop target element, its index, and whether the drop is before/after it, based on the dragover/drop event position.

methods.name: getItemIndex
methods.description: Returns an item's recorded reorder index, or -1 if not tracked.

methods.name: getTargetItemFromEvent
methods.description: Finds the closest ancestor matching itemSelector for a given event's target.

methods.name: evaluateKeyDownEvent
methods.description: Given a keydown event, returns the reorder move it represents (dragged/target elements, indices) for ctrl+shift+up/down, or undefined if it isn't a reorder shortcut or there's nowhere to move.

methods.name: emitEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a CustomEvent with the given name and detail on the host element.

methods.name: addDraggableAttribute
methods.description: Sets the draggable attribute on non-XUL items so native drag-and-drop is enabled for them.

methods.name: isXULElement
methods.description: Reports whether a given element is a XUL element (which is draggable by default, unlike HTML elements).

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns an element's bounding rect, preferring the flush-free windowUtils API when available.

methods.name: onDragStart
methods.description: dragstart listener: identifies the dragged item, dispatches dragstarted, and (in privileged documents) builds a custom drag image.

methods.name: onDragOver
methods.description: dragover listener: computes and displays the drop-position indicator.

methods.name: onDragLeave
methods.description: dragleave listener: hides the drop-position indicator once the pointer truly leaves the list.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: drop listener: dispatches reorder (unless dropped on itself or into a no-op position) and cleans up.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: dragend listener (also called from onDrop): dispatches dragended and clears drag state.
